prompt: Locked camera. Straight away the terrier pushes its head up into the old man's hand, its tail wagging hard and its ears flicking, front paws staying on his knee, mouth closed. He rubs gently behind its ears and along its head, never looking down, his gaze still lifted to the swaying treetops, his small smile deepening slightly. The tall trees bend and their leaves stream in the wind; the hedge rustles. His cup stays in his other hand, the flask and wheelbarrow stay still. Soft grey light, gentle and quiet.
